conditional_shape_fit.scope: Conditional shared10-beta/scale fitting using all8 COCO body observations, train every10th time and diagnose other times. Accepted55-joint rotations FIXED, pelvis world path exactly preserved by translation compensation; shape±3 and scale±8percent bounded. Neither accepted avatar nor motion overwritten. Fixed poses were previously fitted on all frames, so other-times numbers are NOT independent generalization evidence. Shape may absorb detector, pose, clothing and calibration bias; not true anthropometry. Nonzero shape not yet propagated through original LHM neutral rig/query/appearance or rerendered. No global shape adoption from input residual alone.

uv_component.scope: Two distinct cameras on actual CUDA UV renderer, exact convention parity with independent single-mesh route plus nonzero finite geometry gradients. Component contract only, not helmet pose or texture accuracy.

lining_texture.scope: Real original native PNG multiframe/multicamera UV appearance, two best-angle observations per camera then channelwise weighted median across up to16 samples. Positive candidate labels, native mesh self-depth and surface-class agreement, conservative body depth and hand-unknown exclusion. Unobserved texels explicitly marked and repaired by nearby observed same-class colors or class medians/design fallbacks. Not calibrated albedo, relighting or proof of correct geometry/texture; pose/segmentation/lighting errors remain. Requires actual real/novel-view rendering and held-out evaluation. No raw footage/model weights published. Candidate frames first ranked by same-time corrected cross-camera color consistency, with explicit support/error gates. No stage or observed-dark-lining selection; common pose/color bias can still survive.
